description:
Biking just got way more exciting! With vibrant LED lights glowing throughout the bike, the Electro-Light turns every ride into a glowing adventure. Whether it’s zooming down the sidewalk or riding in the driveway, this bike brings unforgettable fun.
Designed with young riders in mind, this bike pairs wide tires for steady balance and confident traction with easy-to-use coaster brakes that make stopping easy and intuitive. The Electro-Light ensure a safe, secure ride every time.
Offering a tool-free adjustable saddle and removable training wheels. This bike adapts as your child grows allowing them to ride with confidence. Build skills and independence every step of the way.
This bikes infinity lights shine through the chainguard, frame, and front plate—wrapping the bike in a 360° glow that’s impossible to miss. It’s not just a ride, it’s a rolling light show that brings the wow to every adventure.
The 16” Huffy Electro-light is made for kids ages 4-6 or between the height of 42 and 48 inches tall.

components.description: Easy & Safe Braking: A simple-to-use coaster brake allows kids to stop by pedaling backward, helping them feel in control.
